links.title: POWLAND 100A 150V MPPT (top pick)
links.note: Top pick. Uses nearly the full array (1,500W at 12V). 4.2★, Prime by Nov 22; used from $120.99

links.title: MakeSkyBlue 100A V124 MPPT (cheapest)
links.note: OK alternative. Caps at 1,200W; only 2 reviews.

links.title: Renogy Rover 40A 100V (spare panels controller)
links.note: Recommended for spare panels only, not the 370s.

links.title: TIDRADIO TD-H3 GMRS 2-pack (top pick)
links.note: Top GMRS pick. USB-C, NOAA; needs a $35 family license (no test).

links.title: Quansheng UV-K5/K6 ham 2-pack
links.note: Needs a Technician ham license to transmit.

links.title: Reolink Home Hub Mini (cheapest, recommended)
links.note: Cheapest hub that works with your solar cams and Home Assistant. microSD not included.

links.title: Reolink Home Hub Mini
links.note: Same Mini as Walmart, slightly more expensive. microSD not included.

links.title: Reolink Home Hub (8-cam, 2 microSD slots)
links.note: More local storage if you need it. HA-tested.

links.title: Reolink Home Hub Pro (no HDD)
links.note: Overkill unless you want 24/7 HDD recording.

links.title: MakeSkyBlue 60A V124 MPPT (cheapest that fits 2S2P)
links.note: OK alternative. Real MPPT, but caps at ~720W.

links.title: MakeSkyBlue 80A V124 MPPT
links.note: Same V124 hardware as the 60A, higher amp rating; caps ~960W at 12V, covers most real-world output. Few reviews so far.

links.title: VUICCI 100A MPPT charge controller, 145V PV (used)
links.note: BOUGHT Nov 17 (arrives Nov 18). You sent this. Works: 145V max vs ~104V cold Voc, ~1,400W at 12V; only buy with 30-day return, lesser-known brand

links.title: ANENJI 100A MPPT 150V (official eBay)
links.note: Real 100A/150V MPPT from ANENJI official (100% positive, 1.2K sold). Free 2–4 day US shipping from NJ. Not an identical VUICCI housing clone, and not cheaper than the used VUICCI at $90.99.

links.title: MakeSkyBlue 60A V124 MPPT (eBay)
links.note: Same V124 60A, free shipping via Google Shopping, but $30 more than Amazon ($66).

links.title: Reolink Home Hub Mini (official eBay US)
links.note: Genuine unit from Reolink Official US (99.6% positive, 3.3K sold). Free shipping from Houston, TX. Still $15 more than Walmart at $69.94.
